2023-10-23
First notice of loss received for a left-turn collision at an intersection. The insured's vehicle was struck while turning
across oncoming traffic, and the claimant reports a wrist fracture from the impact.
2023-11-12
Conifrmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. No issues found with
the policy status.
2023-11-22
Police report obtained. It places the claimant as a passenger in the vehicle and lists the other driver as at fault for
failing to yield on the left turn.
2023-11-29
Photos of the vehicle damage were reviewed. The damage pattern lines up with the described impact, and no earlier
damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspections.
2023-12-21
Statements from the other driver and two independent witnesses match the account given by the claimant. Each
describes the collision the same way, with no conflicting details.
2023-12-27
Medical records show a wrist fracture consistent with the force of this type of crash. No earlier injury to that body area
is on file. Tretament has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the claimant's lawyer has been
notified of the ongoing care.
2024-02-24
Each conversation with the claimant has produced the same account of events. Based on the evidence reviewed, the
claim is progressing as a standard bodily injury and property damage matter, with the representation noted in the file.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
